explication: This repository is an unofficial Android launcher and compatibility shell for running a user-provided Slay the Spire 2 installation. The main workflow is to import or download game files, select a launch profile and compatibility pack, then start the Godot game. Separate launcher capabilities include Steam authentication and downloads, Workshop browsing and installs, save snapshots and cloud sync, file/MOD management, logs, and optional LLM-assisted log analysis. The graph combines README-documented flows with source-index references; unsampled subsystems are represented at their existing directory paths.
